title: Fix three bugs in a Rust VecUtils module
description: Fix bugs in VecUtils: sum uses multiplication instead of addition, product uses addition instead of multiplication, flatten takes only the first element of each inner vec.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. sum: change `total *= num` to `total += num`
2. product: change `total += num` to `total *= num`
3. flatten: replace `result.push(inner[0])` with `result.extend(inner.iter())` (or a for loop) to include all elements
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
